description: The check your agent runs right before it moves money, e.g. 'about to pay out 4,000,000 MXN to a bank via Solana, where will it land and what will arrive?'. Reads the payout in the currency the recipient gets, funded from USDC or USDT on Solana or Base, or from a stated currency. Returns JSON: the payout's value at the official rate (publisher and date), the routes on record ordered by evidence of what landed ("not enough evidence yet" and no rank where thin) with all-in cost against the official rate where a public price exists, landing time and delay risk, the documents the banks are published to ask for, a tracking handle, a compliance manifest, a safety block (confidence, data freshness, sources) and a signature. Free view; every route's full evidence: USD 0.25 per call by x402 in USDC on Base or Solana, or a paid key. Same check: POST https://swapeazi.io/api/v1/pre-payout. Information, not advice: SwapEazi never sends, holds or settles money; the payer's own provider or wallet pays out after a person approves.

access_key.description: A paid key (rk_...), if not sent as a Bearer header.

amount.description: The payout amount in the currency the recipient gets, instead of q.

chain.description: The chain the USDC or USDT is on, if funding from stablecoins.

currency.description: ISO code the recipient gets, e.g. MXN.

from.description: ISO code the payout is funded from, if not stablecoins.

q.description: The payout in plain words: amount and currency the recipient gets, how it lands (bank, mobile money, cash), and the funding chain (Solana or Base).

name: check_before_payout
title: Check before a payout
